{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode=Basketball |year=2018–19 |team=Saint Joseph's Hawks |image=St. Joseph's Hawks Script Logo.gif |image_size=200 |conference=Atlantic 10 Conference |division= |short_conf=A-10 |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=14–19 |conf_record=6–12 |head_coach= [[Phil Martelli]] |hc_year = 24th |asst_coach1=Mark Bass |asst_coach2=David Duda |asst_coach3=Geoff Arnold |asst_coach4= |stadium= [[Hagan Arena]] |champion= |bowl= |bowl_result= }} {{2018–19 Atlantic 10 men's basketball standings}} The '''2018–19 Saint Joseph's Hawks basketball team''' represented [[Saint Joseph's University]] during the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Hawks were led by 24th-year head coach [[Phil Martelli]], and played their home games at [[Hagan Arena]] in [[Philadelphia|Philadelphia, Pennsylvania]] as members of the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]]. They finished the season 14–19 overall, 6–12 in A-10 play to finish in a tie for tenth place. As the No. 10 seed in the [[2019 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]], they advanced to the quarterfinals, where they lost to [[2018–19 Davidson Wildcats men's basketball team|Davidson]]. On March 19, 2019, Phil Martelli was fired after 24 seasons as the head coach.{{Cite web|url=http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/26307312/saint-joseph-fires-martelli-34-year-run|title = Saint Joseph's fires Martelli after 34-year run|date = 19 March 2019}} He ended his tenure at Saint Joseph's with a 444–328 record. Shortly thereafter, the school hired [[Philadelphia 76ers]] assistant coach [[Billy Lange]] as head coach.{{Cite web|url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaab/2019/03/28/76ers-assistant-billy-lange-hired-as-saint-josephs-coach/39268909/|title=76ers assistant Billy Lange hired as Saint Joseph's coach|website=USA TODAY|language=en-US|access-date=2019-11-26}} ==Previous season== The [[2017–18 Saint Joseph's Hawks men's basketball team|Hawks]] finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] 16–16, 10–8 in [[2017–18 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]] to finish in fourth place. They defeated [[2017–18 George Mason Patriots men's basketball team|George Mason]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2018 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]] before losing to [[2017–18 Rhode Island Rams men's basketball team|Rhode Island]] in the semifinals. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
